1: [package]
     2: name = "wg-basic"
     3: version = "0.1.0"
     4: edition = "2021"
     5: rust-version = "1.89"
     6: license = "MIT"
     7: description = "A small Linux-native WireGuard management appliance"
     8: 
     9: [features]
    10: linux-integration = []
    11: # Non-default hooks used only by the disposable systemd update transaction
    12: # qualification. Release workflows must never enable this feature.
    13: update-test-fixtures = []
    14: 
    15: [dependencies]
    16: # Argon2id credential hashing (Phase 7 M002). Default features give the PHC
    17: # self-describing verifier and the OS-CSRNG salt source; `argon2::Params`
    18: # defaults are exactly the policy the management roadmap requires
    19: # (19 MiB, t=2, p=1) and are asserted in `domain::auth`.
    20: argon2 = "0.6"
    21: base64 = "0.22"
    22: clap = { version = "4.5", features = ["derive"] }
    23: # Session cookie construction and parsing (Phase 7 M003). MSRV 1.56, well under
    24: # the repository's 1.89. Used for correct Set-Cookie attribute handling rather
    25: # than for parsing: every cookie this surface accepts is one it wrote itself.
    26: cookie = "0.18"
    27: # Graceful shutdown for the long-running roles. The `termination` feature is what
    28: # makes `SIGTERM` and `SIGHUP` reach the same handler as `SIGINT`: without it
    29: # only Ctrl-C stops these roles, and no process supervisor sends Ctrl-C. A
    30: # `SIGTERM` that the process did not handle killed `serve` mid-flight, skipping
    31: # the stop-accepts / drain / stop-worker / close-DB ordering entirely.
    32: # Portable across Linux and Darwin (M001 macOS foundation).
    33: ctrlc = { version = "3.4", features = ["termination"] }
    34: # Phase 7 (ADR-003): the two direct EggServe crates and nothing above them. The
    35: # router layer, the static-asset layer, and every framework surface are
    36: # deliberately absent: the management service owns its own routing and embeds
    37: # its own assets. `tests/architecture_guards.rs` enforces that.
    38: # Portable: the macOS management surface reuses the same loopback HTTP stack.
    39: eggserve-primitives = "0.2.2"
    40: eggserve-server = "0.4"
    41: futures-util = "0.3"
    42: # Session bearer and CSRF token entropy comes from the OS CSPRNG directly, so
    43: # the randomness source is an explicit, auditable dependency rather than a
    44: # feature of a transitive crate.
    45: getrandom = "0.3"
    46: ipnet = { version = "2.11", features = ["serde"] }
    47: eggpack-manifest = "=0.1.0"
    48: eggup-core = "=0.1.3"
    49: eggup-acquisition = "=0.1.3"
    50: eggup-curl = "=0.1.2"
    51: eggup-eggpack = "=0.1.3"
    52: eggup-service = "=0.1.3"
    53: minisign-verify = "=0.3.0"
    54: nix = { version = "0.30", features = ["fs", "socket", "user"] }
    55: qrcodegen = "1.8.0"
    56: rusqlite = { version = "0.40", default-features = false, features = ["bundled", "backup"] }
    57: # SHA-256 session-token digests. The raw token never reaches SQLite.
    58: serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
    59: serde_json = "1.0"
    60: sha2 = "0.11"
    61: thiserror = "2.0"
    62: tokio = { version = "1.44", features = [
    63:     "macros",
    64:     "net",
    65:     "rt",
    66:     "rt-multi-thread",
    67:     "sync",
    68:     "time",
    69: ] }
    70: uuid = { version = "1.18", features = ["v4", "serde"] }
    71: x25519-dalek = { version = "2.0.1", features = ["getrandom", "static_secrets", "zeroize"] }
    72: zeroize = "1.8"
    73: 
    74: [target.'cfg(target_os = "linux")'.dependencies]
    75: nl-wireguard = "0.3.0"
    76: rtnetlink = "0.23.0"
    77: 
    78: [lints.rust]
    79: unsafe_code = "deny"
    80: 
    81: [lints.clippy]
    82: all = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }
    83: 
    84: # Test-only: integration tests build deliberately damaged databases (invalid key
    85: # rows, dangling relations, future schema stamps) to prove restore fails closed.
    86: # The production dependency set is unchanged by this section.
    87: [dev-dependencies]
    88: rusqlite = { version = "0.40", default-features = false, features = ["bundled"] }
    89: # M003 signing-handoff test only; it creates ephemeral keys and uses no production signer.
    90: minisign = "=0.10.0"
    91: 
    92: [[bin]]
    93: name = "wg-basic"
    94: path = "src/main.rs"
